none beyond one SSH login over loopback (declared mutating so it runs after the accounts exist)
none beyond one SSH login attempt over loopback (declared mutating so it runs after the accounts exist)
none beyond two SSH login attempts over loopback (declared mutating so they run after the key is in place)

action.mutates: one SSH session over loopback as p8testin, idle for up to 30 s; the outcome goes to /run/p8test-ssh/idle.txt

outcomes.outcome: only the class's key exchange, ciphers and MACs are negotiated
a member of an allowed group (sudo, naemon, ssh_in) logs in with a key; a user in none of them is refused even with a valid key
password logins and root logins are refused
an idle session is ended after client_alive_interval (ClientAliveCountMax 0)
the host keys are offered in the given order, and the class's own moduli file is used
the other hardening settings hold (no host-based auth, rhosts ignored, 120 s login grace, empty passwords refused, strict modes, port)
